examples.en: Soon, two wild cockatoos came visiting and one "Dad" bird wanted to find his way into the cage.
examples.zh: 很快，两只野生凤头鹦鹉来访，鹦鹉“爸爸”想找到进入笼子的方法。

examples.en: Penguins, hornbills, flamingos and cockatoos add colour to the bird park.
examples.zh: 企鹅，犀鸟，红鹤和凤头鹦鹉给飞禽公园增添颜色。

examples.en: Layered over the top of all this came the screeches of sulphur-crested cockatoos.
examples.zh: 最上层是凤头鹦鹉，它们发出尖利的叫声。
